title: Two explicit adapters behind one narrow real seam
description: Separate fixture-qualified layout variability from the stable ingestion protocol without creating a generic parser platform.
decision: Define IStatementAdapter with an immutable descriptor, a structural Probe operation, and an Extract operation over PdfDocumentEvidence plus the exact released Ledger AccountDetail selected by preview. AccountDetail is consumed directly so accountId, AccountClass, currencyCode, and masked identity metadata remain authoritative; adapters may not reconstruct, wrap, or privately query account semantics. Register exactly pdf-text-layout-a-v1 and pdf-text-layout-b-v1 explicitly. Run every probe and require exactly one exact match; none or multiple fail closed. Each adapter owns row boundaries, variant-local Source Row Identity, dates, balance-movement direction, controls, exclusions, and exact FinancialEvidence for its qualified fixtures. The adapter does not apply account-class sign conversion: preview composes the existing FinancialNormalizer with the selected AccountDetail.AccountClass, then composes StatementReconciler with the resulting movement and extracted controls. There is no dynamic loading, user-authored rule language, OCR fallback, or generic table parser.
rationale: Two independently qualified adapters make this a real seam. Deleting it would smear detection and row semantics into preview orchestration. A single conditional parser grows into an untestable switch; regex or template configuration turns finance semantics into unreviewed data; per-bank child processes add lifecycle and distribution complexity. C7 and NG4 require the narrow registry.
alternatives: A: one conditional parser, rejected because detection and extraction drift together. B: user-authored regex or template rules, rejected because unreviewed configuration would own financial semantics. C: dynamic plugins or child processes, rejected as unsupported deployment and security complexity. D: two explicit adapters behind IStatementAdapter, chosen because two real implementations exist.
consequences: Each advertised variant requires representative golden fixtures, exclusive structural detection, deterministic extraction, explicit bounds, and a versioned compatibility identity. Adding a third format is an adapter plus evidence change, never a generic fallback. Preview must pass the exact public Ledger AccountDetail into Extract and then use that same AccountDetail.AccountClass with FinancialNormalizer; adapters cannot infer account class or currency from statement text or private state, and cannot create a competing normalization path.
status_notes: Accepted design, corrected during bd-1as preflight to bind selected-account semantics to the released Ledger AccountDetail and to make the existing FinancialNormalizer and StatementReconciler composition explicit before adapter implementation.
